summary: {person} moves a report earlier so riders can question the director before she has to leave.
realLife: Milwaukee’s Transit Plus council kept its normal meeting time and moved the director’s report forward to accommodate her three o’clock departure.
gates: A scheduled witness must leave before the normal question period ends.
weights: Several unresolved rider questions raise the cost of hearing the report too late.
inGame: needs: meeting agenda, director’s availability and public question period.

turns.what: Members ask about the next service change directly.
turns.pulledBy: The early report leaves time for questions.
turns.writesBack: Enter the director’s answers in the minutes.

turns.what: The chair assigns the unanswered items for written reply.
turns.pulledBy: Questions run past the director’s departure.
turns.writesBack: Name the responding office and return date.
